name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v557: fixes TV crash when opening Cloudflare settings. (1) SettingsWebView was an `internal object` (Kotlin singleton); on Android TV the plugin's classloader couldn't find the static INSTANCE field, causing NoSuchFieldError when tapping the Open button in Cloudflare Bypass settings. Converted to a regular class with a companion object so static methods are generated properly. LoginType enum moved to top-level for clean cross-file access. (2) All v556 fixes retained: invisible mode never falls back to visible except at app open, kwik.cx challenges fail silently, pre-playback probe validates the correct mirror, isCookieValid retries transient interstitials, pre-purge clearance snapshot stops stale cookie saves.
